guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：Linux 作業系統協作工程
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Linux operating-system collaborative engineering
guides.concept: 以核心協作、併發機制與版本驗證串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect kernel collaboration, concurrency and version validation with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
procedure: 先觀察師傅的「貢獻邊界」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：核心貢獻需說明問題、範圍與維護責任。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「為自製玩具程式寫明確變更目的。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「架構差異」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：位元組序、對齊與原子語意依平臺而異。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「用玩具 byte 陣列比較兩種解讀。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「EEVDF 語意」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：資格與虛擬截止時間補充公平排程判斷。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「按官方概念繪製玩具候選選擇。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「資源生命」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：引用、釋放與併發訪問需相容。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫玩具物件最後引用與回收。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「測試層次」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：單元、整合與跨架構驗證覆蓋不同風險。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「對玩具變更列需要的具體驗證。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「維護交付」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：長期維護需資料、介面與複核責任。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「釋出僅供本地 toy program 的審查包。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for contribution boundaries. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Kernel contributions state problem, scope and responsibility. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Write a scoped change rationale for a self-made toy program. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for architecture differences. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Endianness, alignment and atomic behavior vary by platform. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Interpret one toy byte array in two ways. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for eevdf semantics. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Eligibility and virtual deadlines refine fair scheduling. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw toy candidate selection from official concepts. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for resource lifetimes. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: References, release and concurrent access must agree. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw last references and reclamation for a toy object. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for test layers. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Unit, integration and cross-architecture checks cover different risks. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Specify concrete checks for a toy change. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for maintenance delivery. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Maintenance retains evidence, interfaces and review ownership. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Package review evidence for a local toy program only. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「版本回歸」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「最後修改的檔案永遠就是故障原因。」為何不成立。
提交「維護交付」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「釋出僅供本地 toy program 的審查包。」如何辨別它們。
提交「維護交付」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「課程完成即等於獲授權修改生產核心。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for version regression; explain why this claim fails: The last-edited file is always the failure cause.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for maintenance delivery; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for maintenance delivery; explain why this claim fails: Course completion authorizes production-kernel changes.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：課程完成即等於獲授權修改生產核心。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Course completion authorizes production-kernel changes. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.

guides.scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.
